notes: HER 0.1.0-hashi.20 makes semantic compaction capacity-driven and request-aware: its provider deadline inherits HASHI's effective idle timeout, is capped by remaining hard time with cleanup grace, never interrupts a selected tool, and fails open without mutating active context. The current turn stays verbatim, complete pre-compaction history remains recoverable, lifecycle events carry correlated timeout and continuation evidence, and completed answers are not held behind maintenance. Linux and Windows x86-64 packages are built from the same clean source commit; the Windows package passed native version, doctor, status, and stdin-capability smokes.
